Card Q&A.a: No, it can't. It can only digivolve into a card with both the [Ghost] and [LIBERATOR] traits.
Card Q&A.q: If I would use this card's  effect to digivolve my Digimon, can it digivolve into a [Ghost] or [LIBERATOR] trait Digimon card?

Effect: [Main] You may play 1 [Ghostmon] or [Violet Inboots] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Your Turn] When any of your [Violet Inboots] suspend, ＜Delay＞.
・1 of your Digimon with the [Ghost] trait may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Ghost] and [LIBERATOR] traits in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 3.
